name: supply-dispenser-import
narrative: Halima runs supply for the chlorine programme, and the checks list tells her, without anyone being asked, that ClearWater Action's dispenser consignment is past its expected date and that three of its import documents are not on file. She opens the consignment, whose checklist names who owes each document, and uploads the packing list and commercial invoice ClearWater emailed straight onto their lines. When the clearing agent sends the customs declaration, she uploads it the same way, and the consignment has every document it needs. She records the customs fee and the clearing agent's charge, each paid to someone other than the donor, and marks the consignment cleared. At its warehouse, Harmattan Health Supplies opens its own update link, with no login, and records the goods-received note: 118 accepted and 2 refused because their tap housings cracked in transit. Through the same link it records the release notes that send 60 dispensers to the Dawaki project site and 50 to Rimi. Back on the checks list that opened the story, nothing is left to report about the consignment. On the order the import reconciles: 120 donated, 118 accepted and 2 refused with nothing still to come, the two charges it took to land them, and every accepted dispenser held at the warehouse, Dawaki or Rimi, kept and moved rather than forecast.

halima.intro: Halima is accountable for getting donated chlorine dispensers from the port to the project sites, and today she learns where each one is by chasing email and WhatsApp.
halima.name: Halima Yusuf

features.description: Attach link on an outstanding checklist line opens the attach form naming that line and its owner, with the kind pre-selected; the uploaded file is stored and the line reads on file.
features.verify: After uploading, GET /supply/shipments/<id>/ shows Packing list and Commercial invoice "on file" with their titles; Customs declaration still "outstanding".

scenes.narrative: She opens the consignment, whose checklist names who owes each document, and uploads the packing list and commercial invoice ClearWater emailed straight onto their lines.
scenes.title: Halima uploads ClearWater's papers onto their checklist lines

features.description: With every required document attached, the checklist has nothing outstanding and each line links to its file.
features.verify: GET /supply/shipments/<id>/ shows all four checklist lines "on file" and no "outstanding" chip.

scenes.narrative: When the clearing agent sends the customs declaration, she uploads it the same way, and the consignment has every document it needs.
scenes.title: The customs declaration completes the checklist

features.description: Record a charge on a shipment with kind, payee organisation, amount, currency, rate to USD and date paid.
features.verify: GET /supply/shipments/<id>/ lists a Customs fee paid to Port customs (duty account) and a Clearing charge paid to Lagoon Clearing & Forwarding; the status reads cleared.

scenes.narrative: She records the customs fee and the clearing agent's charge, each paid to someone other than the donor, and marks the consignment cleared.
scenes.title: Halima records what it cost to land the donation

features.description: The distributor's update link records a goods-received note against the order and the consignment, accepted and rejected separately with a reason, marked as reported by the distributor.
features.verify: After submitting, the order page lists receipt HHS-GRN-2231 at the Harmattan warehouse told by Harmattan Health Supplies with 118 accepted and 2 refused, and the shipment reads delivered.

scenes.narrative: At its warehouse, Harmattan Health Supplies opens its own update link, with no login, and records the goods-received note: 118 accepted and 2 refused because their tap housings cracked in transit.
scenes.title: Harmattan records the arrival and refuses two cracked units

features.description: The link's Record a release form posts a transfer between two of the link's supply points in the ledger, marked as reported by the distributor.
features.verify: GET /supply/stock/ shows Dawaki project site 60 units and Rimi project site 50 units; the link page lists both releases under Recorded through this link.

scenes.narrative: Through the same link it records the release notes that send 60 dispensers to the Dawaki project site and 50 to Rimi.
scenes.title: Harmattan releases dispensers to the project sites

features.description: The lateness and missing-documents checks are derived from the records, so they stop reporting a consignment once it is received and its documents are on file.
features.verify: GET /supply/checks/ for the programme lists no check about KEX-AWB-40981.

scenes.narrative: Back on the checks list that opened the story, nothing is left to report about the consignment.
scenes.title: The checks list has nothing left to report

features.description: The order's match card states what was refused on arrival apart from what is still outstanding, and a durable item's order shows where its units are held now, per supply point, with a total.
features.verify: GET /supply/orders/<id>/ shows Refused on arrival 2 units, Still outstanding 0 units, and Where they are now: Harmattan warehouse 8, Dawaki project site 60, Rimi project site 50, held across 3 places 118 units.
